question: Dehing Patkai Wildlife Sanctuary is located in ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dehing Patkai Wildlife Sanctuary**

 
 
• Dehing Patkai National Park is located in the** Dibrugarh and Tinsukia districts of Assam.**
 
• It covers an area of** 231.65 km2 **rainforest.
 
• It was declared a wildlife sanctuary on **13 June 2004.**
 
• **On 13 December 2020** Government of Assam upgraded it into a national park.
 
• **On 9 June 2021** Forest Department of Assam officially notified it as a national park.
 
• It is located in the Dehing Patkai Landscape which is a dipterocarp-dominated lowland rainforest. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
